content: 1. Carrie Tudor, a nursing specialist affiliated with the International Council of Nursing in the USA, participated as a technical agency end-user. 2. Zarir Udwadia, a clinician based in India, is associated with Hinduja Hospital, Breach Candy Hospital, and Parsee General Hospitals, which serve as referral centers for multidrug-resistant tuberculosis (MDR-TB). 3. Andrew Vernon, a trials expert and staff member of the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), contributed his expertise in clinical trials. 4. Evidence reviewers from McGill University in Montréal, Canada, included Syed Abidi, Faiz A. Khan, Jonathon Campbell, Zhiyi Lan, and Dick Menzies. 5. Charles Daley, a clinician and Chair of the Global Drug-Resistant TB Initiative, is affiliated with National Jewish Health in the United States, a referral center for MDR-TB. 6. Kelly Dooley, an associate professor at Johns Hopkins University in the USA, specializes in clinical trials, pharmacology, and infectious diseases. 7. Gregory Kearns, a pediatric pharmacologist, is based at the Arkansas Children’s Hospital Research Institute in the USA. 8. Anneke Hesseling, a pediatrician and clinical trials expert, is affiliated with Stellenbosch University in South Africa. 9. Gary Maartens, a clinician and pharmacologist specializing in TB and HIV, is based at the University of Cape Town in South Africa. 10. Norbert Ndjeka, a clinician and national TB program end-user, works with the Department of Health in South Africa. 11. Michael Rich, a clinician and technical agency end-user, is affiliated with Partners in Health in the USA. 12. H. Simon Schaaf, a pediatrician and clinical trials expert, is based at Stellenbosch University in South Africa. 13. Valérie Schwoebel, a technical agency end-user, is affiliated with The Union in France. 14. Shenjie Tang, a clinician at Beijing Chest Hospital in China, works at an MDR-TB referral center. 15. Ye Tun, a clinician and member of the National Expert DR-TB Committee in Myanmar, is affiliated with Thingungyun San Pya General Hospital and the University of Medicine. 16. Kitty van Weezenbeek, a technical agency end-user, is associated with the KNCV TB Foundation in the Netherlands. 17. Francis Varaine, a technical agency end-user, is affiliated with Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) in France. 18. Irina Vasilyeva, a clinician and national TB program end-user, is based at the National Medical Research Centre of TB and Infectious Diseases in the Russian Federation. 19. Kerri Viney, a WHO consultant and meeting rapporteur, is based in Sweden. 20. Lawrence Geiter, a trial investigator from Otsuka in the USA, participated via webinar. 21. Crispin Kambili, affiliated with Johnson & Johnson in the USA, contributed as a trial investigator. 22. Carole Mitnick, a clinician from Partners in Health in the USA, participated as a trial investigator. 23. Andrew Nunn, a member of the Medical Research Council in the United Kingdom, contributed as a trial investigator. 24. Essam Elmoghazi, a technical agency end-user from the Regional Green Light Committee in Egypt, participated in the meeting. 25. Mildred Fernando-Pancho, a civil society representative and former MDR-TB patient from the Philippines, contributed her perspective. 26. Anna Marie Celina Garfin, a technical agency end-user from the Ministry of Health in the Philippines, participated in the meeting. 27. Barend (Ben) Marais, a pediatrician from the University of Sydney in Australia, contributed his expertise. 28. Andrei Maryandyshev, a clinician from Northern State Medical University in the Russian Federation, participated in the meeting. 29. Alberto Matteelli, a clinician from the University of Brescia in Italy, contributed his expertise. 30. Giovanni Battista Migliori, a technical agency end-user, is affiliated with the Maugeri Institute in Italy. 31. Thato Mosidi, a clinician and former MDR-TB patient from South Africa, represented civil society. 32. Nguyen Viet Nhung, a national TB program end-user, is the Director of the National TB Control Programme in Vietnam. 33. Rohit Sarin, a technical agency end-user, is affiliated with the National Institute of TB and Respiratory Diseases (NITRD) in India. 34. Welile Sikhondze, a national TB program end-user, is part of the National TB Control Programme in Eswatini. 35. Ivan Solovic, a clinician and national TB program end-user, is affiliated with the National TB Programme in Slovakia. 36. Pedro Suarez, a clinician and technical agency end-user, is associated with Management Sciences for Health in the USA. 37. Carlos Torres, a clinician and technical agency end-user, is affiliated with the Latin American Thoracic Society in Colombia. 38. Draurio Barreira Cravo Neto, an observer from UNITAID in Geneva, Switzerland, participated in the meeting. 39. Edward M. Cox, from the US Food and Drug Administration in Washington, DC, USA, attended as an observer. 40. Jennifer Furin, from The Sentinel Project in the USA, participated as an observer. 41. Brian Kaiser, from the Global Drug Facility at the Stop TB Partnership in Geneva, Switzerland, contributed as an observer. 42. Lindsay McKenna, from the Treatment Action Group (TAG) in New York, USA, participated as an observer. 43. Ya Diul Mukadi, from the US Agency for International Development (USAID) in Washington, DC, USA, attended as an observer. 44. Eric Pelfrene, from the European Medicines Agency in London, United Kingdom, participated as an observer. 45. Anna Scardigli, from the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, TB, and Malaria in Geneva, Switzerland, contributed as an observer. 46. Soumya Swaminathan, Deputy Director-General for Programmes at WHO, attended the meeting. 47. Tereza Kasaeva, from the Global TB Programme at WHO, participated in the meeting. 48. Additional WHO staff from various regional offices and departments contributed to the discussions.
